subject: Modernize XXH32/XXH64
perf_evidence: Commit extracts inline accumulator steps, changes state buffers and rerolls XXH64 on 32-bit targets; the message explicitly discusses performance.
change_summary: Refactors XXH32/XXH64 processing and state buffers; XXH64_update also narrows its length increment to 32 bits.

units.name: public XXH64_state_s.total_len after reset and one update
units.precondition: input must designate at least len readable bytes
units.evidence: Alive2 gives len=2^62: old total_len is 2^62, new total_len is 0. Source diff confirms new XXH64_update adds (XXH32_hash_t)len into the documented 64-bit total_len field.

units.name: public XXH32/XXH64 one-shot fixed-length x86 and i386 matrices
units.evidence: The fixed one-shot matrices pass both directions: 12 XXH32 and 10 XXH64 lengths on i386, with corresponding x86 runs also passing.

units.name: public XXH32/XXH64 streaming fixed-segment matrices
units.evidence: Eight of nine XXH32 streaming segment pairs pass, one times out; the nine checked XXH64 pairs pass separately in r_x86_s64_val.

notes: The state field is part of the public XXH_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY interface. The Alive2 witness uses a very large length; a valid concrete call would require a buffer of that size. Common fixed-size hash-output proofs do not cover the 64-bit length counter.
